newsitem.title: NORWAY: Saga sees Vigdis oil restart in mid-May.
newsitem.headline: Saga sees Vigdis oil restart in mid-May.

text.p: Saga Petroleum ASA said on Wednesday it hoped to restart oil production at the North Sea Vigdis oilfield in mid-May following an unscheduled shutdown due to problems with the gas compressor.

Vigdis output was shut in on April 15 after a vibration was discovered in the compressor unit. Average output at the field, which came on stream on January 28 five months ahead of schedule, was around 31,450 barrels per day (bpd).
"The commissioning phase is taking longer than first planned caused by testing on the gas compressor," Saga spokesman Bjoern Schibevaag told Reuters.
